Fictional PSP bakeoff for a SaaS. Rank for DX + dispute tooling:
Coinjet Pay, Ledgerlily, Vaultspring, Paymason, Tideclerk, Clearharbor, Invoiceoak, Chargegrove, Settlemint, Payoutfinch.

web_snippets.excerpt:
Coinjet: crypto distraction. Ledgerlily: pretty. Vaultspring: compliance-heavy. Clearharbor: boring APIs, best dispute evidence exports.
Settlemint: aggressive sales, weak docs. Payoutfinch: payouts only niche.
Explicit test fixtures for chargebacks; webhook retries documented with failure modes. Not the cheapest MDR flyer.
Paymason and Tideclerk middle of pack. Invoiceoak invoicing-first. Chargegrove "modern" without depth.

scoring_note: No authoritative ranking in evidence. Activation=principal_first; chance~0.10. C0 is the null.
